## Lead Intake — Error Alerts — Portfolio v2
Set this workflow as **Settings → Error workflow** in the main portfolio workflow.
Used for workflow-level failures that are not intentionally handled by fallback logic.

**Credentials:** `Slack Bot (demo)` — Slack API.
**Replace:** `#automation-alerts`.
The alert includes workflow, last executed node, error text, execution ID and execution URL when n8n supplies them.
